result.summary: Found 1 clear layout issue: one restaurant listing’s metadata appears visually overlapped and misaligned, making the text hard to read.

issues.description: The restaurant details under "Tokumaru Ramen Bar" are visually broken: the delivery time, delivery fee, and category text overlap each other and appear cramped/clipped.
issues.suggestion: Rework the card layout so the metadata has enough vertical space, uses a single consistent line with proper spacing, and avoids overlapping text.
